summary: SiteDocuments is a web user control for managing documents, including uploading, editing, filtering, assigning destinations and disciplines, and handling workflow actions for site-related documents. The control enables administrators and users to add, edit, delete, sort, and categorize documents by type, section, discipline, and allowed destinations. It supports granular access via disciplines/subdisciplines and implements validations, business rules, and dynamic UI behavior.
purpose: To provide an interactive interface for managing site-specific documents, allowing users to upload files, select document types and disciplines, assign destinations, and maintain metadata. It supports granular access restrictions, file handling, categorization, and workflow-based operations such as saving, canceling, and assigning applied children.
actors: System for auto-generated fields and file handling

workflows.name: Upload and Save Document
steps: User initiates upload via FormView control.
FileUpload control captures file and metadata.
HandleUploadedFile creates unique folder, saves file, and sets file attributes.
SaveDocument assigns document fields (type, name, section, discipline, comments, file info).
If a previous file exists, it is deleted.
Document saved to database; UI redirects to current page.

workflows.name: Edit Document
steps: User clicks Edit; FormView loads document data.
User modifies fields; saves or cancels changes.

workflows.name: Assign Destinations
steps: User manages ListBox controls for included/not-included destinations.

workflows.name: Assign Disciplines
steps: RadioButtonList toggles allow-all or specific subdisciplines.
UI visibility and binding based on selection.

workflows.name: Row Command Workflow
steps: GridViewCommand events for Add, Edit, Delete, Sort, EditAppliedChildren.
HandleAdd, SetupEditButton, SetupDeleteButton, HideDetails, ShowDetails manage UI and state.

business_rules: Only users with editable screen can add/edit/delete documents.
DocumentType codes are filtered by OmitTypeCodes.
If a previous document exists, its file is deleted before upload.
Disciplines and destinations are assigned only if allowed and not restricted.
All disciplines option triggers clearing ListBox values.
If no included discipline is selected, all disciplines are automatically allowed.
If uploading, file must not be empty.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator enforced for mandatory fields; disabled in Edit mode.
UserSession presence checked for most actions; cancels operation if null.
SubDiscipline selection handled by RadioButtonList logic.
calculations: FileType via DocumentTypeConversion based on content type.
conditions: If UseSubDisciplines: discipline filters and assignment enabled.
If RestrictedSubDisciplines: filtering and note in UI.
If fileURL is empty: no file delete operation.
If included discipline ListBox is empty: AllowAllSubDisciplines true.
FormViewMode Insert/Edit controls UI visibility and binding.
system_behavior: Auto-generate fields and controls from designer file.
Dynamic UI elements based on Mode (Insert/Edit/Display).
Section headers and CSS classes for grouping rows.
Redirect after Save/Delete for UI update.
Show/hide upload note panel based on FileUploadNote.
Dynamic JavaScript setup for details and discipline logic.
dependencies: Codes for document type code category.
Grid and FormView controls for UI and data binding.
Resources for UI text and labels.
exceptions: Invalid file upload: no save performed.
Discipline/restricted subdisciplines not present: disabled UI elements.
Omitted type codes: document type code removed from dropdown.
content_gaps: Exact field validation logic (regex, format) not present.
No explicit error handling code for failed directory creation or file save.
Details about GenericDocument, DestinationCode, Discipline class definitions are not fully included.
Specific business exceptions and warnings are inferred, not all explicitly listed.
